name: Altendorf (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, red and yellow, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Altendorf (a black bar and a white bird on red).
history: Municipal flag of Altendorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Altendorf arms — bar and bird on red
